reason: Pseudo-classes the old parser did not know (or wrote in another case) were dropped, so the rule matched as if they were absent; Chrome drops a rule with an unknown pseudo-class / pseudo-element (or one it rejects: `:matches()`, `:-moz-any()`, `:selected`) and evaluates the ones it knows (`:lang()`, `:defined`, `:scope`, `:FIRST-CHILD`). Consolidation S3b: the html2pdf / surf-static cascade parses and matches with turbo-dom's selector engine.
